dataset.name: UCI Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones
dataset.citation: Anguita, D., Ghio, A., Oneto, L., Parra, X., and Reyes-Ortiz, J. L. (2013). A Public Domain Dataset for Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones. ESANN.

protocol.dataset: UCI Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones (240)
protocol.flattening: time-major C order: time 0 channels 0..8, then time 1 channels 0..8, etc.
protocol.split: Official subject-disjoint train/test; sorted 21 training subject IDs dealt round-robin into three sites of seven; fixed across seeds.
protocol.bounds: Per-channel pooled TRAIN minimum and maximum, widened by 10% of range; same nine bounds repeated across all 128 timesteps; no test access.
protocol.patient_preprocessing: Unmodified release bounds and totalizes each window, averages features over each subject and selects the modal activity with lowest-label tie break. Seven effective training sequences per site. This is not per-subject clipping of a loss evaluated on all windows.
protocol.central: Identical model and public initial arrays, identical bounded subject-pooled training tensors, five round-local SGD epochs, same batch size and learning rate; no clipping or noise. All 21 subjects pooled centrally.
protocol.trivial: Constant TRAIN window class-frequency probabilities; classification uses the TRAIN majority activity.
protocol.scoring: One final held-out scoring pass after all model settings and training are frozen. Window-level macro OVR AUC, accuracy, log-loss. No test feature/label reads during preparation or training.
protocol.gap: federated_dp macro_auc minus central macro_auc, paired by seed; mean and sample SD
protocol.diagnostic: At epsilon 8, mean federated accuracy exceeds the TRAIN-majority predictor's held-out accuracy and mean macro AUC exceeds 0.5; also report each replicate.
protocol.fallback: If LSTM cannot execute, GRU may be attempted once with its own unchanged registry defaults and the identical protocol, only if the failure is LSTM-specific. Shared package/mechanism failures stop execution with BLOCKED_SEQUENCE.md. No alternative on low utility alone.
protocol.selection: No schedule search, pretraining or inner-validation selection. No setting changes after scoring.
protocol.randomness: Seeds fix public model initialization. Node-owned cryptographic secrets retain release semantics; public seeds do not control DP noise and are not a promise of exact DP replay. Fresh node secrets per replicate remain unarchived.
